mapper.select: with acquired as materialized ( select pg_advisory_xact_lock( hashtextextended(concat(octet_length(#{tenantId}), ':', #{tenantId}, octet_length(#{idempotencyKey}), ':', #{idempotencyKey}), 0) ) ) select 1 from acquired

with acquired as materialized ( select pg_advisory_xact_lock( hashtextextended(concat(octet_length(#{tenantId}), ':', #{tenantId}, octet_length(#{eventSource}), ':', #{eventSource}, octet_length(#{eventId}), ':', #{eventId}), 1) ) ) select 1 from acquired

select wf.id from batch.external_event_expectation_definition expectation join batch.workflow_definition wf on wf.tenant_id = expectation.tenant_id and wf.id = expectation.workflow_definition_id and wf.calendar_code = expectation.calendar_code where expectation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and expectation.event_code = #{eventCode} and expectation.enabled = true and wf.enabled = true order by wf.id for share of expectation, wf

select tr.* from batch.trigger_request tr left join batch.trigger_request_idempotency_alias alias on alias.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and alias.request_id = tr.request_id and alias.idempotency_key = #{dedupKey} where tr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and tr.parent_workflow_run_id is null and (tr.dedup_key = #{dedupKey} or alias.idempotency_key is not null) order by (tr.dedup_key = #{dedupKey}) desc limit 1

select tr.request_id, tr.trace_id, tr.request_status, tr.related_job_instance_id, ji.instance_status, tr.updated_at from batch.trigger_request tr left join batch.job_instance ji on ji.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and ji.id = tr.related_job_instance_id where tr.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (tr.dedup_key = #{dedupKey} or exists ( select 1 from batch.trigger_request_idempotency_alias alias where alias.tenant_id = tr.tenant_id and alias.request_id = tr.request_id and alias.idempotency_key = #{dedupKey} )) and (cast(#{externalEventSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as varchar) is null or tr.external_event_source = #{externalEventSource})
mapper.insert: insert into batch.trigger_request_idempotency_alias (tenant_id, idempotency_key, request_id) values (#{tenantId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestId}) on conflict (tenant_id, idempotency_key) do nothing
mapper.select: select request_id from batch.trigger_request_idempotency_alias where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert:
insert into batch.trigger_request ( tenant_id, request_id, trigger_type, job_code, workflow_definition_id, biz_date, dedup_key, request_status, trace_id, dry_run, external_event_code, external_event_source, external_event_id, launch_payload ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{requestId}, #{triggerType}, #{jobCode}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{bizDate}, #{dedupKey}, #{requestStatus}, #{traceId},
#{dryRun} false , #{externalEventCode}, #{externalEventSource}, #{externalEventId}, cast(#{launchPayload,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as jsonb) ) on conflict (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, external_event_source, external_event_id) where external_event_source is not null do nothing
